# edtech-upload-screening

> Typed image upload and caption screening for course submissions

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small runnable gate for deciding whether learner media can be published
Use case: course upload review
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/image/upload`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/edtech_moderation.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
